title: Restricted dialTcp bridge v1
description: Narrow TCP byte-stream API over the WASM userspace netstack. Not SOCKS. Not UDP. Not a fetch gateway. Not a port scanner.

host.description: Tailnet IPv4/IPv6 or MagicDNS name previously selected by the user. The bridge does not enumerate or probe other hosts.

port.description: Single destination port, typically MonkeyCraft 9600. No port ranges.
